items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I remember when Dewey Redman’s son came up Dewey was saying man my son is so and so and so.

ctx.x: Right. How much room is there at the top.

That’s right. McCoy Tyner and some of them, they do small bands, combos, big bands, they got names. But I mean it takes a while for a kid to come up and make a name for himself and if he may have a hot record, how many of them fly-by-night hotshots came up and you don’t know nothing about ‘em now. I mean you know. I remember when Dewey Redman’s son came up Dewey was saying man my son is so and so and so. And I thought it really was going to effect him one time, he said man my son is doing this and he’s a star and…
